{{Event Infobox
| Name  = We Meet Again!
| Image = Event-WeMeetAgain.png
}}
{{E|We Meet Again!}} is a shrine [[Event]] found in all [[Acts]].

Shrine events appear less frequently than other events.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Give Potion}} {{TS|negative||Lose a chosen potion.}} {{TS|positive||Obtain a Relic.}}
* The event will randomly choose a potion upon entry and tell you which one was selected. You will be unable to drink or discard that potion until you leave the event's floor.

{{Frame|Give Gold}} {{TS|negative||Lose Gold.}} {{TS|positive||Obtain a Relic.}}
* The amount of [[Gold]] lost is between 50 and 150 (or your current amount of [[Gold]]).

{{Frame|Give Card}} {{TS|negative||Lose a chosen card.}} {{TS|positive||Obtain a Relic.}}
* The chosen card will not be {{QueryLink|Cards|rarity:Basic|Basic}} or a {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Curse|Curse}}.

{{Frame|Attack}} Nothing happens.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"We meet again!" <br>
A cheery disheveled fellow approaches you gleefully. You do not know this man. <br>

"It's me! {{TS|gold||Ranwid!}} Have any goods for me today? The usual? A fella like me can't make it alone, you know?" <br>
You eye him suspiciously and consider your options.
</div>
<blockquote>
{{Frame|Give Potion}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"Exquisite! Was feeling parched." <br>
{{TS|blue|up|Glup glup glup}} <br>

He downs the potion in one go and lets out a satisfied {{TS||shake|burp.}} <br>
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Give Gold}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"Magnificent! This will be quite handy if I run into those {{TS|red||mask wearing hoodlums}} again."
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Give Card}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"Exemplary! I shall study this further in my chambers."
</div></blockquote>

<div style="font-style:italic">He rummages around in his various pockets... <br>
"Here, look what I've got for you today! Take it take it!"</div>
</blockquote>

{{Frame|Attack}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"{{TS||shake|Aaaaagghh!!}} What a jerk you are sometimes!" <br>
He runs away.
</div></blockquote>

</blockquote>

== Notes ==
* "{{TS|red||mask wearing hoodlums}}" likely refers to the group of bandits in the Act 2 event {{E|Masked Bandits}}.
